tractability._primary: READ site_hypothesis_basis FIRST. No site was established in this run. Every number below describes a CAVITY that fpocket found in 3MOP; none of them is a measurement of the Myddosome death-domain interface, and the highest-scoring one is a hydrophobic core.

pocket_volume_a3._min_max_withheld: DELIBERATELY NULL. The two measured cavity volumes are 253.8 A^3 at D=1.6 and 273.2 A^3 at D=2.4 in 3MOP. They are NOT pooled into a min/max here because site_pocket_selected_by is max_druggability_no_ligand_site, which does not identify a site — so a spread built from them would not be a spread of one site's volume. Rule 4b: report them per structure or not at all. They are reported per structure, here.
pocket_volume_a3._primary_note: 253.8 A^3 at D=1.6 and 273.2 A^3 at D=2.4 in the single structure 3MOP. THIS IS NOT A SITE VOLUME. site_pocket_selected_by is max_druggability_no_ligand_site — 'the most druggable pocket anywhere in the scored chains' — which by rule 4b does not identify a site at all. There is no ligand to anchor to (3MOP carries zero nonpolymer ligands) and no second structure to establish persistence, so nothing selected this cavity except its own score. Volume is an absolute quantity and these two numbers are real measurements of a real cavity; they are simply not about the interface this dossier asks about. The 210/240 A^3 guide is withdrawn and may not be revived, so the fact that 253.8 lands between them means nothing.

pocket_druggability._min_max_withheld: DELIBERATELY NULL. The measured value is 0.890 at BOTH D=1.6 and D=2.4 in 3MOP, so a pooled range would read 0.890-0.890, fold_range 1.0 — a spuriously stable number. It is withheld for the same reason as the volume: max_druggability_no_ligand_site does not identify a site, so there is nothing for a spread to be a spread OF. The single per-structure value is stated here and in site_pocket_rank.
pocket_druggability._comparability: WITHIN ONE STRUCTURE (3MOP), across the D sweep — 0.890 at both D=1.6 and D=2.4. Not pooled across structures, because there is only one. AND IT MUST NOT BE READ AS A SITE VALUE FOR TWO INDEPENDENT REASONS. First, site_pocket_selected_by is max_druggability_no_ligand_site, the path rule 4's _do_not_max clause says must never produce a reportable value; it is circular here, since the pocket was chosen BY this score. Second, and decisively, the pocket is a buried hydrophobic core — see _buried_core below. A high number here is not evidence for the mechanism and it did not contribute to the verdict.
pocket_druggability._provenance: shipped fpocket 4.2.3: a 3-descriptor logistic regression fitted on 21 positives against 292 others, whose dominant term is min-max normalised over the current structure's own 134 pockets. A weak prior, not a probability.
pocket_druggability._false_negative_rate: REPORTED, NEVER LOAD-BEARING. This run is a FALSE POSITIVE rather than a false negative, and it is the more instructive direction: 0.890 is the highest druggability value in either IRAK4 dossier, and it sits on the mechanism that returns insufficient_evidence, while the mechanism that returns small_molecule_tractable scores 0.413 on a 1.40 A holo crystal with a drug bound. If this score were load-bearing the two verdicts would invert.
pocket_druggability._do_not_max: max-over-pockets measures pocket count: r(n_pockets, max druggability) = 0.702. 3MOP carries 134 pockets at D=1.6 and 124 at D=2.4 — a 14-chain assembly is exactly the kind of file that inflates this path. It fired here and the value it produced is reported only so a reader can see what it produces.
pocket_druggability._buried_core: enclosure 0.998 >= 0.98 (sealed, no solvent mouth), subunit_enclosure_gain 0.02 <= 0.05 (buried within one subunit, not by the assembly), apolar lining fraction 0.833 >= 0.7. This is the shape of a hydrophobic core, and fpocket's druggability regression rewards precisely that shape. TREAT THE DRUGGABILITY SCORE ON THIS POCKET AS UNINTERPRETABLE, not as a high one.

site_pocket_rank._note: Reported for completeness and NOT as a site claim. The ranked pocket is a hydrophobic core, not a site. Note also that the two within-structure orderings disagree sharply and in opposite directions across the sweep: fpocket ranks it 1 of 134 at D=1.6 while PRANK ranks it 10, and at D=2.4 fpocket ranks it 5 of 124 while PRANK ranks it 4. Rank 1 of 134 by a score the pocket was selected by is not an independent finding.

cryptic_evidence._note: The apo census the cryptic call rests on. Vajda 2018: cryptic only if the site is absent in all, or nearly all, unbound structures.
cryptic_evidence.basis: NOT MEASURED, and the null is the finding. pocket_scan returned cryptic_status 'not_run' with reason 'needs both an apo and a holo structure; got 0 holo reference and 1 apo'. There is exactly one PDB entry that models the IRAK4 death domain (3MOP) and it is ligand-free, so no apo-versus-holo comparison exists to make. cryptic_pocket_risk is set to high on that basis — an unmeasurable crypticity on a pure-apo, single-structure death fold is an absence of measurement, and rule 3 says a low or absent pocket score in that situation is not evidence of poor tractability.
cryptic_evidence.definition: Vajda et al. 2018 / CryptoBench pocket-residue RMSD > 2 A. The criterion is named so a reader can see it was NOT applied, rather than applied and passed.

pocket_vs_interface._note: Measured, not assumed. Requires a complex structure containing the partner.
pocket_vs_interface._why_not_classified: THE PARTNER STRUCTURE EXISTS AND THE CLASSIFICATION STILL COULD NOT BE MADE, which is a different thing from having no partner and is recorded here rather than hidden behind the enum. The interface stage ran (interface_status 'ok') and found 191 interface residues across the MyD88/IRAK4/IRAK2 assembly. But pocket_scan's own consensus came back 'numbering_mismatch_not_interpretable' and it excluded 3MOP: only 23 of 107 shared residue NUMBERS name the same residue in both the scored assembly and the partner epitope set (identity fraction 0.215 against a 0.9 threshold), with mismatches like '19: MET vs ILE' and '20: LEU vs ARG'. The cause is structural, not a bug in the numbering: 3MOP holds THREE different proteins whose chains are each numbered from ~1, so a seqid-keyed comparison that does not carry the chain collides MyD88 residue 19 with IRAK4 residue 19. A constant offset cannot repair it (offset_ours_to_partner = 0, not applied). Every seqid-keyed field — overlap_fraction 0.462, interface_coverage 0.107, the six shared residues — is therefore matching non-homologous positions and is NOT reported above. The GEOMETRIC fields are unaffected and are what the buried-core call rests on. classification is set to no_partner_structure because that is the only enum value that does not assert something unmeasured; matches_mechanism_hypothesis is false because the pocket found is demonstrably not a destabiliser candidate.

_chain_attribution_verified_by_residue._note: Rule 2b / chain attribution. Verified by residue, not assumed from the chain flag. Entity map from pdb_v.polymer_entities: A-F MyD88 Q99836, G-J IRAK4 Q9NWZ3, K-N IRAK2 O43187.
_chain_attribution_verified_by_residue.reading: 12 of the 13 lining residues are on chain G = IRAK4's OWN death domain, and the single remaining one (D/58) is MyD88. The cavity is inside one IRAK4 protomer. It is not at an inter-protein interface, so it cannot be the thing that destabilises the assembly.

_buried_core_test.thresholds_status: PROPOSED, NOT CALIBRATED — derived from this single observed case, so they gate a flag and never a filter.
_buried_core_test.reading: enclosure 0.998 means the cavity has effectively no solvent mouth; a gain of only 0.02 from adding the rest of the assembly means it is buried WITHIN one subunit rather than BY the oligomer; 0.833 apolar lining over nine Leu/Ile/Val/Phe/Pro residues completes the picture. This is the shape of a folded protein's hydrophobic interior, and fpocket's druggability regression rewards precisely that shape. It is why 0.890 is uninterpretable rather than high.

tractability.clash_attribution: Not computable. Clash attribution requires a ligand to transfer from a holo reference, and there is no holo death-fold structure anywhere — not for IRAK4, and not across the 221 death-fold PDB entries surveyed. This is a null for want of a reference, not a null result.
tractability.caveat: This computed axis measured almost nothing, and saying so IS the result. Four of the five stages either did not run or were not interpretable: cryptic not_run (needs an apo/holo pair, has 0 holo), mdpocket not_run (needs >=2 structures, has 1), interface ran but its residue-keyed output is not interpretable across a three-protein complex, and the site-selection route degraded to max_druggability_no_ligand_site, which does not identify a site. Only fpocket detection and the geometric burial test produced usable numbers, and what they say is that the best-scoring cavity in the Myddosome is the death domain's own hydrophobic core. Chain selection was ASSERTED as all 14 chains per rule 2b, which is the correct unit for oligomer destabilisation, and it is a different assertion from the companion orthosteric run: these two dossiers describe the same accession and share ZERO residues.

affinity._why_null: Rule 13: there is no affinity predictor in this deployment, so rule 12's mandatory positive control is unsatisfiable rather than skipped. The correct response to an unsatisfiable control is a null with a stated reason, never a prediction reported without one. Note what was available and deliberately not used: IRAK4 has an excellent control compound to hand (CHEMBL4443947, IC50 0.022 nM in a characterised MBP-substrate kinase assay). Having the control and no predictor is still no prediction.

PRIMARY — is the top-ranked pocket a site at all? Is there ANY drug-like ligand precedent at this fold? NO, and it was measured rather than assumed. 221 distinct death-fold PDB entries (PF00531 Death + PF00619 CARD + PF01335 DED + PF02758 PYRIN, COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id); the naive sum of the four families is 225 because 4 entries carry two). next_experiment.description: A structure of the IRAK4 death domain, or of the Myddosome, with ANY drug-like ligand bound at a death-fold surface — obtained by crystallographic or cryo-EM fragment screening against the assembly, not by computation. Failing that, a biophysical fragment screen (SPR or NMR) against the isolated IRAK4 death domain reporting a hit rate, which would establish whether the fold is ligandable at all before any site question is asked.
next_experiment.rationale: The verdict is insufficient_evidence and every branch that could have changed it is closed for the same structural reason: there is exactly one PDB entry that models this domain (3MOP, 3.4 A, ligand-free), so there is no holo/apo pair to measure crypticity with, no second structure to fix a site by construction with, and no ligand to anchor a pocket to. Computation cannot manufacture any of these — rule 3 says a low or absent pocket score under those conditions is an absence of measurement, and this run's high score is worse than absent, because it is a hydrophobic core scoring 0.890. Across 221 death-fold PDB entries there is not one synthetic drug-like ligand at a death fold, so the fold-level prior offers nothing to transfer either. What is missing is an experiment, not an analysis.
next_experiment.resolves: Whether the Myddosome death-domain interface is ligandable at all. A single fragment-bound death-fold structure would convert this axis from unmeasured to measurable: it would supply the holo reference that unlocks the cryptic comparison, the anchor that lets a site be identified by something other than max_druggability_no_ligand_site, and the second ensemble member that mdpocket needs.
